headerDisplay: HomeKit control for WLED candles: one Candles tile with a dimmable light, fades, and a named list of looks (presets 1-5).
footerDisplay: Give the controller a fixed address (a DHCP reservation in your router).

host.title: Controller address
host.description: IP address or hostname of the WLED controller, e.g. 192.0.2.10 or wled-controller.local.

fadeInSeconds.title: Fade-in (seconds)
fadeInSeconds.description: How long the candles take to come up when turned on. WLED allows at most 65 s.

lookControl.title: How looks appear in the Home app

oneOf.title: Look list as a separate tile
Switches in the Candles tile (no labels in the tile)

lookListAlwaysOn.title: Look list usable while the candles are off
lookListAlwaysOn.description: Lets you choose a look while the candles are off (it turns them on), but the Home app then shows the tile as On even while the candles are off. Off: the tile status is accurate; turn the candles on, then choose a look.

slotTurnsOn.title: Choosing a look also turns the candles on

pollSeconds.title: Polling interval while the live connection is down (seconds)

offlineGraceSeconds.title: Show No Response after the controller has been unreachable for (seconds)

offlineSensor.title: Add an "online" contact sensor
offlineSensor.description: Closed while the controller responds; usable for Home app notifications.

id.title: Accessory ID
id.description: Identifies the accessory in HomeKit. Changing it creates a new accessory (scenes must be rebuilt).
